def get_tags_gff3(tagline):
    """Extract tags from given tagline"""

    tags = dict()
    for t in tagline.strip(';').split(';'):
        tt = t.split('=')
        tags[tt[0]] = tt[1]
    return tags

def strip_prefix(string, strip):
    """
    Strips a prefix from a string, if the string starts with the prefix.

    :param string: String that should have its prefix removed
    :param strip: Prefix to be removed
    :return: string with the prefix removed if it has the prefix, or else it
        just returns the original string
    """
    import re
    strip_esc = re.escape(strip)
    if re.match(strip_esc, string):
        return string[len(strip):]
    else:
        return string

def between_markers(text: str, begin: str, end: str) -> str:
    """
        returns substring between two given markers
    """
    return ('' if len(text.split(begin)[0]) > len(text.split(end)[0]) and
                begin in text and end in text else
            text.split(begin)[-1].split(end)[0] if begin in text and
                end in text else
            text.split(begin)[-1] if begin in text else
            text.split(end)[0] if end in text else text)
